title: Conflict, Feasibility, Faithfulness, Displacement: Four Quantities That Come Apart in Federated Dual-Cone Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18014v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: FedFV, FedGH and FedMGDA+ aggregate client updates with multi-objective gradient aggregators to remove conflict between them. We examine this rationale with UPGrad, which increases no client's loss to first order, in a comparison that changes only the direction of FedAvg's update. Four quantities the rationale treats as one -- conflict between client updates, feasibility of their weighted mean, faithfulness of the transmitted updates to the clients' gradients, and displacement of the update -- come apart. Under Dirichlet partitioning UPGrad improves CIFAR-10 accuracy by +0.78 pp (14/15 seeds, p < 0.001), only with full participation; on Oxford-IIIT Pet its +0.52 pp gain vanishes (+0.07 pp) once the data our protocol left unused are kept. Varying only the Dirichlet concentration, the gain grows with heterogeneity, yet the split with the most conflict shows none. Uniform client weights, blind to conflict, match the CIFAR-10 gain and exceed

translated_title: 冲突、可行性、忠实性、位移：联邦双锥聚合中相互分离的四个量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18014v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：FedFV、FedGH 和 FedMGDA+ 采用多目标梯度聚合器来聚合客户端更新，以消除客户端更新之间的冲突。我们使用 UPGrad 来检验这一理论依据——UPGrad 在一阶意义上不会增加任何客户端的损失，并且在对比实验中仅改变 FedAvg 更新的方向。该理论依据视为同一事物的四个量——客户端更新之间的冲突、其加权平均的可行性、传输更新对客户端梯度的忠实性、以及更新产生的位移——实际上会相互分离。在 Dirichlet 数据划分下，UPGrad 将 CIFAR-10 的准确率提升了 +0.78 个百分点（15 个随机种子中有 14 个提升，p < 0.001），但仅在所有客户端完全参与时成立；在 Oxford-IIIT Pet 数据集上，一旦保留了我们协议中未使用的数据，其 +0.52 个百分点的增益便消失了（仅剩 +0.07 个百分点）。仅改变 Dirichlet 浓度参数时，增益随数据异质性的增加而增长，然而冲突最严重的划分却未显示出任何增益。对冲突毫无感知的均匀客户端权重在 CIFAR-10 上达到了相同的增益，并超过了……
tldr: 该论文通过仅改变更新方向、不改变幅度的 UPGrad 对照实验证明，联邦学习中多目标梯度聚合方法所依据的“消除客户端更新冲突”理论混淆了四个本质不同的量（冲突、可行性、忠实性、位移），实验表明消除冲突并不必然带来性能提升，均匀权重即可匹配其增益。
en_tdlr: Through a controlled comparison using UPGrad—which alters only the direction of FedAvg's update—this paper shows that the rationale behind multi-objective federated aggregators conflates four distinct quantities (conflict, feasibility, faithfulness, and displacement), and demonstrates empirically that removing client-update conflict does not necessarily yield performance gains, as uniform weights match the improvement.
